description: This file contains functions related to cropping image elements, including calculating uncropped dimensions, adjusting crop positions, and handling resize and flip transformations within a graphics or drawing application.

methods.name: cropElement
methods.description: Calculates new crop dimensions and position based on user interaction, handling aspect ratio constraints and flipping.

methods.name: getUncroppedImageElement
methods.description: Returns an image element with crop applied, unrotated and unscaled, representing the original uncropped image.

methods.name: getUncroppedWidthAndHeight
methods.description: Calculates the width and height of an image element without cropping.

methods.name: getFlipAdjustedCropPosition
methods.description: Adjusts crop position accounting for element flipping and optionally returns natural or scaled crop coordinates.
